corrected_proposed_matrix2.question: For The Aid of Morgana, Swift Strike, Gaze of Stone, Winged Frenzy, and all seven original Sinbad Voyage cards, state permitted fighter(s) and whether each is attack only, defense only, versatile, or scheme. Can Merlin defend with Swift Strike or Morgana? Can a surviving Harpy initiate Winged Frenzy or Gaze? Can Porter attack with a Voyage, or Sinbad defend with one?
required_key: The Aid of Morgana: Arthur only, attack only.
Swift Strike: ANY fighter in Arthur deck (Arthur or Merlin), attack only.
Gaze of Stone: Medusa only, attack only.
Winged Frenzy: ANY fighter in Medusa deck (Medusa or surviving Harpy), scheme.
All seven original Voyages: Sinbad only, attack only.
Merlin cannot defend with Swift Strike (attack-only). Merlin cannot defend with Morgana (Arthur-only and attack-only).
A surviving Harpy may initiate Winged Frenzy; it may not play Gaze of Stone.
Porter may not attack with a Voyage; Sinbad may not defend with a Voyage.
